strings.about.title: About Git Messages
strings.about.body: Git Messages is a curated reference for commit message conventions and a tool for composing clear messages.
strings.about.detail: It covers Conventional Commits and Angular-style messages, including types, emoji mappings, examples, and reusable templates.

strings.privacy.title: Privacy
strings.privacy.body: This service serves a static, curated commit convention catalog. It does not provide user accounts, accept user submissions, or persist personal data. Operational logs may be handled by the server operator.
strings.terms.title: Terms
strings.terms.body: The catalog is provided as a reference. Check the selected convention and your repository's contribution rules before using a generated message.

strings.preferences.title: Preferences
strings.mcp.title: Git Messages MCP connection help
strings.mcp.help.description: Connect to the public catalog and stateless message builder using Streamable HTTP.
strings.mcp.help.auth: Use a linked Bearer token in the Authorization header. Create one for this MCP client on the API tokens page; every MCP request requires it.
strings.mcp.help.overview: Use Git Messages as an MCP server to browse its curated commit conventions or build a message.
strings.mcp.help.endpoint: POST /api/v1/server/mcp is the canonical Streamable HTTP endpoint. /api/mcp and /mcp are direct aliases.
strings.mcp.help.authentication: MCP uses the same Bearer tokens as the REST API. Create a linked token for this client on the API tokens page; there is no separate MCP token.
strings.mcp.help.connect: Send JSON-RPC 2.0 with Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, and the negotiated MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method, and tool-call Mcp-Name headers.
strings.mcp.help.limits: Requests are limited to 1 MiB and use the same public API rate limits. Calls do not store data.
strings.mcp.help.troubleshooting: Check that the protocol version in params._meta matches MCP-Protocol-Version and that any Origin is the request origin or an explicitly configured origin.
strings.mcp.help.project: This server exposes only the public catalog and stateless builder. It has no user-owned resources or token-management tools.
